blind.table_distance_name: folded cloth tied with a ribbon
blind.description: A neat bundle of folded tan or beige woven fabric (shroud or blanket) stacked in four layers and tightly bound around its midsection by a wide dark red or crimson ribbon. The fabric surfaces have a distinct woven linen or burlap texture with rounded, realistic folded edges. The underside rests flat against the ground without an extra base, and there are no disconnected floating elements or defects.
blind.from_above: A rectangular block of beige woven cloth crossed by a dark red horizontal band across its middle, casting a shadow towards the top.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 8 to 10 inches tall (less than one-sixth the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and roughly 1 to 1.3 feet wide.
